def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators = [
        ("row", r) for r in range(h)
        if 2 * r + 1 == h and len(set(grid[r])) == 1
    ] + [
        ("col", c) for c in range(w)
        if 2 * c + 1 == w and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
    ]
    if len(separators) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one centered separator, got {separators}")
    axis, idx = separators[0]
    if axis == "row":
        first, second = grid[:idx], grid[idx + 1:]
    else:
        first = [row[:idx] for row in grid]
        second = [row[idx + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in first for x in row) & set(x for row in second for x in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one shared panel color, got {shared}")
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == color and second[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(first[0]))] for r in range(len(first))]
